docs.text: "Known to some as the “Freshwater Everest,” if you want to explore this mountain, you don’t go up, you go down." "In the middle of Lake Superior, near the boundary between Canadian and US waters, sits the Superior Shoal, a mountain that’s completely underwater."

The Superior Shoal is an underwater mountain that rises nearly 300 meters/980 feet from the bottom of Lake Superior. Superior Shoal is 70 kilometers/44 miles from the closest shoreline. Its remote location in the center of Lake Superior has left it something of a mystery.
